evidence.limits: No whisper.srt available. Speech comes from the broadcaster's burned-in subtitles. This is a 314 s Reel and the contact sheets sample one frame every 3.14 s (6 per sheet), so most subtitle lines between samples were not seen and only the sampled lines are quoted; story structure is therefore described at section level. The hook sheets are 4 fps but very wide and small. Music and sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Kan 11 TV interview with Matan and his partner Livnat on becoming a millionaire by 23, their view of employees versus business owners, Livnat's courses and book, and their advice to young people.
audience: General Israeli TV and Instagram audience; young people interested in early wealth; also a critical audience reacting to the couple's views on salaried workers.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption promises 'tips for becoming millionaires at 23' and promotes the Kan 11 programme 'ערב עם שי שטרן' tonight at 22:00; the video is a five-minute Kan 11 interview excerpt, not a talking-head tip list. The Reel is published by the broadcaster account (kan_israel) as a collab with the programme and Matan, not by Matan.

opening.first_frame: Livnat in a selfie-style clip (silver top, apartment kitchen behind) with a double-line subtitle at the bottom and a headline at the top reading 'אני פה כדי לספר לכם ששיקרו לכם'; Kan 11 logo top right, programme logo bottom left.
opening.s0_1: Livnat speaks to camera; headline text builds up: 'אני פה כדי לספר' then 'לכם ששיקרו לכם'.
opening.s1_3: Headline adds 'ויש מלא צעירים' then 'ועשירים בישראל.'; subtitle repeats the same line.
opening.s3_5: At about 4 s cut to a clip of Livnat standing at an apartment door, 'ברוכה הבאה לדירה שלנו'.
opening.visual_hook: A young woman in a luxury apartment directly addressing the viewer with a challenge.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0.0 s and same as the subtitle: 'אני פה כדי לספר לכם ששיקרו לכם ויש מלא צעירים ועשירים בישראל' (machine transcript, 0 to 4 s).
opening.text_hook: אני פה כדי לספר לכם ששיקרו לכם / ויש מלא צעירים ועשירים בישראל
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'אני פה כדי לספר לכם ששיקרו לכם' is a self-contained opening claim
opening.works_without_sound: yes: subtitles and headline carry the sentence

visual.subject_placement: Broadcast two-shot: Matan and Livnat on a grey sofa, the interviewer Shai Stern on the right; shots alternate between a wide three-shot and medium close-ups of Matan and Livnat.
visual.setting: A bright interview set with a bookshelf, grey sofa and red heart art on the wall; Livnat's apartment; Matan's office whiteboard and a wall panel; a dark stage.
visual.lighting: Even broadcast light in the studio, natural light in the apartment, stage lighting with a white screen in stage clips.
visual.color_contrast: Neutral, bright and soft; blue shirt and grey blazer; broadcaster subtitles in white with a black outline.
visual.props_and_gestures: Sofa conversation, gestures with open palms, Matan presenting a wall panel of dots (a week tracker) and a whiteboard with numbers to the interviewer.
visual.supporting_footage: Clips of Livnat's own social videos (a selfie clip, a door entrance clip, a podcast clip), clips of Matan on a stage, a tour of his home office with a wall panel, whiteboard and chess art, a short street vox pop ('כמה אתם משלמים על שכירות?'), a TikTok-style insert with subtitles.
visual.persistent_branding: Kan 11 logo, top right throughout; programme logo ('ערב עם שי שטרן'), bottom left; the end card is Kan's logo 'דיגיטל. רדיו. טלוויזיה.'
visual.faces_blurred: yes (street vox pop passers-by at about 1:05-1:09 are blurred except the couple); studio faces unblurred
visual.visual_progression: 0-4 s Livnat's selfie clip; 4-12 s apartment and podcast inserts; 12.6 s start of the sofa interview; interview intercut with her clips (1:31-1:34), Matan on stage (1:53-1:56, 3:39-3:43), a street vox pop (1:05-1:09), the home-office tour (2:21-3:05); return to sofa; 3:52-3:55 podcast clip of Livnat; 4:45 Livnat clip with headline 'תקשיבי לזה'; 5:10 Kan end card.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is a sofa frame with Matan and Livnat and the subtitle 'מה שהופך אותי בעצם מעצמאית לבעלת עסק.'
visual.ui_interference: Subtitles sit at the bottom (inside the bottom 35 percent zone); Kan logo is top right at the top edge; the headline at 0 to 4 s is inside the top 14 to 25 percent.

editing.edit_function: Broadcast cut: alternation between two-shot and close-ups follows who speaks; inserts of Matan on stage or Livnat's videos illustrate what the speaker says; the vox pop adds an outside voice.
pacing_changes: t=0-12s: fast cold open with three short clips
t=12.6-60s: long interview coverage in shots of 3 to 6 s
t=2:21-3:05: home-office tour as a different location
t=5:10: cut to a white end card
editing.ending: Interview closes with 'תהיו חברים של אנשים שכירים, הם אנשים יותר טובים.' (about 5:04) and 'תודה. תודה רבה' (5:07); the last 3 s show the Kan logo end card on white.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: very low; at 5 minutes it works as a TV excerpt, not as a looping Reel.

sound.delivery: Conversational broadcast speech; after the opening line the machine transcript is noisy (names and several phrases garbled), only the first 120 s of the 314 s are transcribed; a gap in speech at about 10.8 to 12.7 s and at 21 to 65 s the segments are sparse in places.
sound.sync: Subtitles follow the speech with the usual broadcast lag; speaker changes are matched by cuts to the speaker.

text.colour_coding: none (white subtitles with a dark outline); one headline word in green at about 4:45 in Livnat's own clip.
text.placement: Subtitle at the bottom centre; name lower-thirds for guests ('ליבנת אורינובסקי' and 'מתן ניסטור') at about 22 s and 2:02; headline lines at the top in the opening clip.
text.style: Broadcaster subtitles, white on a soft shadow, no box; sparkle name lower-thirds.
text.density_and_read_time: Two-line subtitles for 3 to 6 s each; high density over five minutes.
text.language: Broadcast conversational Hebrew with sharp claims about employees and business owners; sampled lines include 'אני מחפשת יותר בסביבה שאני נמצאת איפה' and 'תהיו חברים של אנשים שכירים'.
text.caption_structure: A teaser line: 'רוצים להיות מיליונרים בגיל 23? לליבנת ומתן יש כמה טיפים בשבילכם', then a programme hashtag and airing time ('הערב בשעה 22:00 בכאן 11 ובכאן BOX').
text.rtl_notes: Subtitles render correctly; sampled frames show some line-break splits across two lines.

story.setup: Livnat's opening claim that young people can be rich; the interviewer welcomes Livnat and Matan.
story.stakes: Whether the couple's views (salaried workers vs entrepreneurs, being a millionaire at 23) are credible and likeable.
story.progression: Introductions; her business and friends; questions about salaried people ('אנשים שכירים משעממים אותך?'); a street vox pop on rent; her book and courses; Matan's stage speech on 'modern slavery'; home-office tour with a week-tracker panel and whiteboard; how they met; Matan's views on business owners and customers; advice to young people.
story.payoff: Advice closing: surround yourself with salaried people since they are better people; thanks.
story.resolution: Interview ends with thanks and the Kan end card.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the opening promise of millionaire tips is not delivered as a list; advice appears as conversation fragments
friction_points: t=0-12s: three different clips before the interview starts (interpretation)
t=30-60s: a long stretch of interview with the interviewer's questions (interpretation)
t=2:21-3:05: home-office tour is long for a Reel (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 44 comments is not representative. Mostly hostile reactions to the couple, especially Livnat (e.g. 'דור אבוד', 'חומר אנושי ברמה נמוכה', 'אנטיגוניזם במלוא הדרו'), about her remarks on salaried workers and her age and style; a few fans or neutral replies ('אהבתי את שי', 'התוכן דווקא מצחיק'); one hostile comment about Matan's book.

rights_and_privacy: Broadcast material owned by Kan (public broadcaster) and published by its account as a collab; includes the interviewer Shai Stern, Livnat, clips of other creators' screens, and a street vox pop with blurred bystanders. Not reusable without Kan's permission.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a major TV brand's account, a provocative cold open (a young woman saying 'you were lied to' about wealth), and a polarising couple produce a lot of comments (798 comments on 367K views); the format is easy to watch with subtitles.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the length (5 minutes), the broadcast pace and the strong negative reaction to the guests may limit completion and shares (the dossier lists 5 shares).

standout_moments.what: Cold open on Livnat's own video: a direct claim before the TV interview starts.
Street vox pop ('כמה אתם משלמים על שכירות?') with the couple: breaks the sofa format.
Matan on a dark stage ('עבדים היינו' / modern slavery line): his keynote persona in a TV interview.
Home-office tour with a wall panel and a whiteboard of numbers: visual proof of his routine.
Closing advice 'תהיו חברים של אנשים שכירים' that contradicts the earlier tone.
